review:
The 2020 cowboy game on Megaways, with up to 117,649 ways, multiplier wilds and a double chance option for the bonus.

In free spins, every wild sticks with its multiplier for the rest of the round, and retriggers extend it. Because the ways keep changing while the wilds stay put, results vary a lot. Up to 5,000x, 96.44% RTP. For fans of the original who want the bigger Megaways grid.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
